nodes.label: Program Plan A to E
nodes.rationale: Phase-level work plan (scope in/out, spec, exit criteria, rough execution) for the consolidated roadmap; the contract that each phase-start executable plan implements.

nodes.label: End-state commitment (production-ready checklist)
nodes.rationale: Functionally complete against the block map, operationally ready (CI, backups, alerting), security/compliance ready (K1-K3 hardened, PDPO, Singapore residency), commercially ready with the acceptance test: body #2 onboards without hand-holding.

nodes.label: Phase C Body engaged
nodes.rationale: The external validation gate; 7+2 questions (original seven plus external-evidence handling and session-granularity), behavioural phrasing per the Q5 rule; MCHK fallback at +2 weeks silence.

nodes.label: Phase M2 CPD engine live
nodes.rationale: Engine half (body_rules per Q26, deterministic evaluator, evaluator versioning Q27, issuance, roster, retro-trust) + governance half + debt closure; then the M2 freeze review and scoped unfreeze.

nodes.label: Phase M3 Signed & verifiable
nodes.rationale: AWS/KMS (ECC_P256 sign-only ap-east-1), sign-certificate, verify-record public URL, staff TOTP mandatory with amr-freshness gating, email cron, calendar links, unfreeze wave 1.

nodes.label: Phase D/M4 Pilot-complete lean cut
nodes.rationale: Thin UI slice (organiser accreditation UI + CPD Ledger wallet v1) + 2 real accredited events + evidence pack accepted + invoice paid; auditor portal/external activities/session UI/AI deferred to E.

nodes.label: Phase E Production-ready
nodes.rationale: Waves: external activities + evidence locker, session/track model, auditor portal, org self-serve admin, comms v2, reports v2 + zh-HK, production hardening; B7 AI/B8 detection demand-triggered, possibly post-E.

nodes.label: Block map (K1-K3 kernel / B1-B8 domain blocks)
nodes.rationale: B1 events/attendance, B2 registry, B3 credit engine incl. external activities + evidence locker, B4 certification + public verify, B5 comms, B6 auditor evidence; B7 AI/B8 detection advisory-by-design and demand-triggered.

nodes.label: Cross-phase invariants
nodes.rationale: Three-lens phase-completion + live backtest; three-layer validation; audited definer functions audit-insert-last; Hard Rule 11 with negative tests; frontend freeze until M2; Q26 before anything config-referencing; no deploy by momentum.

nodes.label: Q30 Payments (Stripe pass-through, HKMA-avoidance)
nodes.rationale: Stripe as placeholder only, no build now; hard constraint structured to avoid HKMA regulation - pass-through processing, Eventar never holds client money, no stored-value mechanics; invoice-first through E.
